name: Fair-value-gap fill in the day direction on a straight path
why: As smc_ob_dp, with the most recent unfilled fair value gap as the pullback level: the one-sided move in the day direction left no two-way business, and the first return is filled by the side that missed it. Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_smc_path_direction.md).

scan.when: (abs(px-open)/max(hod-lod, 1) >= p && sign(px-open) == ((abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr)*sign(at(9,50)-open) + (1-(abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr))*(!rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1)*sign(gap))) && ((((abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr)*sign(at(9,50)-open) + (1-(abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr))*(!rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1)*sign(gap)) > 0 && (lag(5, fvgt(5,m)) == fvgt(5,m) && lo(5,1) < fvgt(5,m) && cl(5,1) > fvgt(5,m))) || (((abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr)*sign(at(9,50)-open) + (1-(abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr))*(!rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1)*sign(gap)) < 0 && (lag(5, fvgbs(5,m)) == fvgbs(5,m) && hi(5,1) > fvgbs(5,m) && cl(5,1) < fvgbs(5,m))))

stop: max(0.1*atr, 0.25 + max((((abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr)*sign(at(9,50)-open) + (1-(abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr))*(!rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1)*sign(gap)) > 0)*(px - fvgb(5,m)), (((abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr)*sign(at(9,50)-open) + (1-(abs(at(9,50)-open) > 0.25*atr))*(!rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1)*sign(gap)) < 0)*(fvgts(5,m) - px)))
